instructions: Preheat the oven and prepare all ingredients for sheet pan chicken and green beans.
Season the chicken and vegetables evenly while the oven reaches temperature.
Arrange the chicken, legumes, and vegetables so heat can circulate around each component.
Bake until the chicken is safely cooked and the vegetables or grain base are tender.
Rest the sheet pan chicken and green beans briefly, adjust the seasoning, and divide it into four portions.
